member.name: N:TingenWebService.Trove
member.summary: A collection of resources used by the Tingen Web Service.
member.remarks:
The Trove is a collection templates, preset values, and other resources used by the Tingen Web Service to format data in a consistent manner.
The Trove contains:
User-modifiable templates (e.g., log files, error messages)
Preset components (e.g, list of required directories)
Preset messages (e.g., welcome messages, notifications)
- Preset messages (e.g., welcome messages, notifications)
